name: Epsilon Apparel
old_description: We are a One Stop, Full Package Apparel Manufacturing House in Los Angeles. We use the Tukatech Digital Pattern, Grading and Marking System for fast, accurate and efficient turnarounds to smooth out the Apparel Development & Manufacturing process.
about:
Epsilon Apparel operates as a full-package apparel manufacturing house in Los Angeles, California. The company provides end-to-end services from pattern development through production cutting and sewing, using the Tukatech digital pattern, grading, and marking system to accelerate turnarounds.

Its service lineup includes pattern making, apparel development consulting, sample prototyping, and production management. Production runs start at 100 to 150 units per style, depending on size and colorway complexity, with sample development completed in 24 to 72 hours. The facility handles both contemporary and activewear collections, though headcount and floor space are not disclosed.

The company serves fashion brands, independent designers, and clothing lines needing extra capacity during transitions or overload periods. Clients range from startups launching their first collection to established labels requiring supplemental pattern-making or production management support.

Epsilon positions itself as a service-oriented partner that works within client parameters, describing its role as "a few extra pairs of hands" during critical production phases. The Tukatech system is cited as the backbone for fast, accurate pattern grading and marking.
